raw.details:
Hackdays 2.O

A One-Day Hackathon | Theme: Best Use Of Google Gemini API

About The Event:

Theme : “Best Use of Google Gemini API Keys”

DEADLINE FOR PPT SUBMISSIONS IS UPTO 4th OCT — TILL 12:00 PM

 

  • PPT Template : Click Here

Hackdays is a hackathon organized by the HackBase society of Galgotia College of Engineering and Technology. It fosters innovation and nurtures tech-driven skills among students, encouraging them to ideate, create, and design their own solutions. The event provides a platform for participants to explore new possibilities while also building upon existing technologies and AI. By refining and transforming current ideas, students are empowered to develop innovative solutions and enhance their practical understanding, ultimately driving their growth as future tech innovators And this time the solutions of our participant will revolve around the "Best use of Google Gemini API key".

  • This hackathon is focused on building innovative technology solutions that solve real-world problems in areas like AI, Education, Health care, Sustainability and many more by "Making the Best Use of Gemini API Keys".
With MLH (Major League Hacking) as our esteemed partner, participants gain access to a global-standard hackathon experience, industry-level mentorship, and opportunities to showcase their work on an international stage.Participants are free to choose any problem statement, as long as it aligns with the theme and demonstrates a deep and meaningful implementation of the Google Gemini API.
 
New to Google Gemini? Go through this link: Click Here
 
Submission Guidelines :
  • All submissions must be made through the Unstop platform.
  • Only submissions on Unstop will be considered for evaluation.
  • The submission mmust align with the format and within the guidelines provided.
  • Any project submission failing to align with Gemini API integration will be disqualified even before the detailed evaluation.
  • The PPt submission is mandatory, github link, live demo link are optional (projects with these additonal details will be prioritized).
  • No submission requests will be entertained once the deadline ends.
Shortlisting Process:
  • Shortlisted teams will be announced on Unstop.
  • Additionally, shortlisted teams will receive an official notification via email.

Judging Criteria:

Judges will consider both the strength of the idea and the team's ability to effectively communicate and demonstrate its implementation. The following criteria will be used as a general evaluation framework:

Round 1 — PPT Evaluation

  • Problem Understanding & Relevance — 25%
  • Innovation & Creativity — 25%
  • Technical Feasibility — 20%
  • Proposed Solution — 20%
  • Potential Impact — 10%
Eligibility:
  • Open to students from all colleges/universities.
  • Team size: 2–4 members per team.
  • Free registration — no participation fee.

Guidelines : 

  • All Team members should belong to the same college.
  • All participants must ensure that the submitted project is their own. Plagiarism, including copying code from online repositories, will not be tolerated and lead to disqualification.
  • The project must align with the given theme.
  • Use of libraries, frameworks, and APIs is allowed.
  • All deliverables must be submitted within the specified deadline; late submission will not be permitted.
  • Each participant must carry their College ID card during the offline round.

Competition Structure:

  • Round 1: PPT & Prototype Screening: In this round, teams are required to submit their presentation (PPT), a screenshot of the prototype, and a corresponding GitHub repository. The presentation must strictly follow the provided template.
  • Round 2 - Offline Round: Successful teams from the first round will advance to an Offline Round held at the Galgotias Campus One. Where there will be a Prototype development and demonstration. Based on various criteria, the best one will be selected to win.

Rewards and Benefits:

  • Total prize pool: Goods, Prizes and Vouchers Worth Rs. 1.5 Lakhs+
  • Unstop E-Certificates for all participants.
  • E-Certificates from HackBase for all participants in offline round.
  • Meals and refreshments during the offline event.
  • Networking opportunities with mentors and fellow participants.
  • A real-time competition from Inter-College and an Inter-disciplinary environment.

Communication Channel :

Mandatory step for the communication purposes. All the necessary communication related to the hackathon will be provided through our offical communication channels provided below.

Event WhattsApp Group: Click Here

Instagram Page: Click Here

LinkedIn Page: Click Here

If you’re ready to push boundaries and create something extraordinary, this is the best time to accomplish it.
